name: Fix: SDVariable.eval() returns detached copy to survive session destruction

fix.change: eval() and eval(Map) now return result.dup() — detached copy with independent DataBuffer
fix.root_cause: destroySession() iterates nodeOutputs and closes all DataBuffers. eval() returned a reference sharing the same DataBuffer with nodeOutputs. When convertToConstant/convertToVariable calls closeAllSessions(), the caller's array becomes closed.
